subject: Recap: data pathway, success metrics & pilot onboarding (next steps)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Clare Mitchell <clare.mitchell@zenpath.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@zenpath.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Recap: data pathway, success metrics & pilot onboarding (next steps)

Thanks for a productive conversation this morning — quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. I pulled this together from our notes; please flag anything I misunderstood.

Key pain & goals (what we heard)
- Production latency spikes during batch reprocessing; impacts user experience during peak hours.
- Prediction drift / hallucination on domain-specific entities (product codes, internal taxonomy).
- Data residency & SSO requirements for EU customer subsets; preference for restrictive egress.
- Goal: validate a Redwood-powered inference path that reduces p95 latency, maintains or improves intent+entity accuracy, and meets data controls.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks, non-production)
- Environment: two serving configs (low-latency optimized + cost-optimized quantized)
- Dataset & prompts: ~120 prompt/eval pairs supplied by ZenPath; we’ll run A/B prompt sets and a held-out eval.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 400ms (target), intent accuracy >= 95% on labeled set, hallucination rate reduction vs baseline (TBD metric).
- Owners: ZenPath product sponsor — Clare (decision owner), ZenPath infra — Raj (data+access). Redwood: Sofia (AE, PM for pilot), Jonas (CS engineer — infra/observability), Ben (solutions engineer — model/quant config).

Access & setup items (what we need from ZenPath)
- A service account or ephemeral S3 access for the eval dataset (sample subset first).
- SAML metadata for SSO test and team RBAC (we can run one-off SSO validation in sandbox).
- Contact for network egress restrictions and any allowlist IPs.

Timeline (proposal)
- 11/16 — HubSpot mutual action plan + DocuSign SOW sent (Sofia)
- 11/17 — ZenPath provides sample dataset + SSO metadata (Raj)
- 11/18 — Redwood provisions sandbox environment; kick off baseline run (Jonas)
- 11/22 — Mid-pilot sync & first eval readout (all)
- 11/25 — Pilot wrap, metrics report, and next-step recommendation (all)

Attachments I’m including: pilot_scope_mvp.xlsx (scope & milestone checklist), access_instructions.pdf (how to share credentials safely), prompt_sample.csv (format for the 120 examples).

Immediate asks (from us to you)
1) Can Raj share a small sanitized sample (<= 500 rows) by EOD 11/17 for our initial sanity checks?
2) Clare, are the success metrics above aligned, or do you want us to swap intent accuracy for a business metric (e.g., task completion rate)?

If that looks good I’ll: 1) create the HubSpot MAP and push the SOW, 2) loop in infra to schedule provisioning, and 3) queue the prompt/eval runner.

Thanks again — excited to get this running.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Clare Mitchell <clare.mitchell@zenpath.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@zenpath.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: data pathway, success metrics & pilot onboarding (next steps)

Thanks, Sofia — this is excellent and captures the conversation. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Agreement on scope and timeline — 4 weeks looks right. We’d like a short mid-point readout focused on both latency and a small business KPI: conversion rate on the search flow (we’ll provide baseline).
- Success metrics: switch intent accuracy target to >= 93% (we want a slightly more conservative threshold) and add conversion uplift >= 4% (or statistical significance).
- We will supply a sanitized sample by 11/17; Raj will take point on files and SSO metadata.

On compliance/SSO: we need your SOC 2 documentation and details on where logs are retained (duration, redaction options) before we can sign the SOW. If you can include that in the HubSpot MAP or a shared Drive link that would help speed procurement.

I also attached our SSO matrix for reference (zenpath_sso_matrix.xlsx).

Looking forward to the mid-week kickoff.

Best,
Clare Mitchell
Head of Product | ZenPath
clare.mitchell@zenpath.com
(212) 555-0104

Subject: Fwd: Recap: data pathway, success metrics & pilot onboarding — action items for engineering

Forwarding Clare’s confirmation — quick internal split of work so we can hit the 11/18 provisioning target.

Jonas — can you:
- Provision sandbox with 2 serving configs (low-latency, quantized) and wire tracing for p95 calculation.
- Add observability hooks and a simple dashboard (cost + latency + errors).
- Confirm expected infra ETA and any IP allowlist needs.
- Link: JIRA SUP-1234 (pilot: env + observability).

Ben — can you:
- Prepare the initial quantization config and run a warmup test with small sample once provisioning is ready.
- Draft a short runbook for prompt versioning and the eval harness; include how we’ll report hallucination rate.

I’ll: 1) create the HubSpot MAP and upload the SOW, 2) send DocuSign, and 3) coordinate with Clare and Raj for the sample dataset.

—
Sofia
